decisions.reason: Selecting the revised physical design does not change the existing obligation to provide a basic wiring plan.
The design selection may inform later component choices, but the source establishes no specific change to the component-selection or BOM deliverables.
The source's adoption of the revised design and barista-facing pour orientation are already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The source's green-accent requirement is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE.
The retained machine wording and the Karla's Matcha Mixer name are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE.
The source's requirement to preserve the DJ-turntable visual identity is already represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE.

Adopting the revised design does not alter the existing V1 speed or off-the-shelf sourcing policy, and the freelancer's simpler-build assessment establishes no additional client-directed state change.
The source's deep-well form requirement is already represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE; no additional attribute change or removal is required.
The source's splash-control target is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE.
